name: dustbringer
description: Surgebinders who wield Division and Abrasion. Dustbringers embrace power others fear, learning self-mastery through destruction. They seek to understand their own nature by controlling what could burn down the world.
sprenDescription: A flickering form wreathed in embers and ash, constantly smoldering. Ashspren are volatile yet deeply concerned with self-mastery and controlled destruction.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Dustbringer acknowledges the destructive nature of their power and accepts responsibility for controlling it.
quotes: I will learn to control the power within me.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: They swear to use their strength with discipline, choosing when not to destroy even when they could.
quotes: I will hold to my oaths, even when my anger burns hot.
I will master the fire, not be consumed by it.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: They claim command over their full destructive capability, guided by principle, not passion.
quotes: I am not the flame. I am the hand that controls it.

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: They embrace both peace and wrath, becoming a weapon when needed, but never without purpose.
quotes: I bring destruction, so that others may be preserved.
